messages.subject: vtest with expressions
parts:
Hi everyone -

I've updated vtest to be able to save R graphical output from anything (including base and grid graphics), not just ggplot2.

Here is an example test script that would go in a package's visual_test/ directory. I've put the output here:
http://stdout.org/~winston/vtest-expression/html/expression_examples.html
==================================
vcontext("expression_examples")

# Works with base graphics
save_vtest2("base graphics", { 
  plot(1:10, (1:10)^2)
})

# Works with grid
library(grid)
save_vtest2("grid graphics", {
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(rectGrob(width=unit(1,"cm"), height=unit(1,"cm")))
})

# Works with ggplot objects
save_vtest2("ggplot2 graphics", {
  ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
})

# Can find vars in parent environment
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg))
save_vtest2("ggplot2 graphics - vars in parent", {
  p + geom_point()
})

end_vcontext()
===================================

Code is here:
https://github.com/wch/vtest

-Winston
